noQr.title: No QR Code Detected
noQr.description: We examined this image using native barcoding detectors and comprehensive image algorithms, but could not detect a readable QR code.
noQr.tip1: Ensure the 3 large corner locator squares are clear and not cut off.
noQr.tip2: Avoid high glare, heavy shadows, or severe blurriness.
noQr.tip3: Crop the image closer to the QR code if it is a small part of a large photo.
noQr.tip4: Ensure sufficient contrast between the dark and light patterns.
